project_title: Vishal Jadon — YouTube Growth Manager Portfolio Rebuild

color_palette.color_rules: Dominant theme is YouTube Red + Crisp White. Charcoal and obsidian black are used ONLY for cinematic depth, shadows, and contrast overlays. Prohibited: solid black full-page backgrounds, purple, blue, neon green gradients.

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase leading-none
hierarchy.section_heading: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase
hierarchy.mono_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-red-600

visual_enhancers.play_button_3d: Realistic physical 3D YouTube Play Button with metallic bevels, red mirror finish, specular highlights, and contact shadows.
visual_enhancers.out_of_screen_effect: Breaking-the-frame depth technique where the 3D Play Button crosses canvas clipping planes, moving into viewer space with camera perspective, dynamic field of view, and soft directional shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-white/40 shadow-xl for floating nav and interactive overlay cards.
visual_enhancers.lighting_and_shadows: Direct key light (pure white), fill light (subtle red bounce), soft directional ambient light to highlight bevels and metallic surfaces.

storyboard_and_scenes.title: Opening — 3D Play Button Frame Break
storyboard_and_scenes.description: Website opens with NO Vishal portrait visible. A giant 3D physical YouTube Play Button floats in 3D space, moving toward the viewer and breaking the screen boundary.

storyboard_and_scenes.title: Continuous Scroll Transition — Reveal Hero
storyboard_and_scenes.description: On scroll, camera orbits and enters the 3D space around the Play Button, revealing real Vishal sitting physically ON/AROUND the Play Button along with main heading CREATOR × STRATEGY × MONETIZE and YOUTUBE GROWTH MANAGER.

storyboard_and_scenes.title: Floating Growth 3D Visuals
storyboard_and_scenes.description: 3D data indicators (+1.2M views, subscriber counters, subtle metric particles) float around Vishal in 3D space as scroll progresses.

storyboard_and_scenes.title: 3D Work Ecosystem (Worked With)
storyboard_and_scenes.description: Interactive 3D ecosystem featuring real channels (Acharya Prashant, Josh Talks Hindi, Zee Switch, Unknown Facts Hindi) floating at distinct depths and angles.

storyboard_and_scenes.title: Real Press Credential / ID Card Journey
storyboard_and_scenes.description: Real ID card travels from deep background z-space, revolves 360 degrees, approaches foreground for clear hold/readability, and exits into background.

storyboard_and_scenes.title: Real Event & Proof Gallery
storyboard_and_scenes.description: Authentic work and conference photos emerge after ID exit, displaying real evidence and events.

storyboard_and_scenes.title: Contact Workspace & CTA
storyboard_and_scenes.description: 3D workspace backdrop with ambient red lighting, displaying Instagram (@vishjd) and Email (Infovishaljadon@gmail.com) CTAs.

instructions_to_main_agent.mandatory_data_testid: Every interactive element (buttons, links, nav, inputs, channel cards, contact links) and key text/stats MUST contain a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
instructions_to_main_agent.no_placeholders: Use ONLY provided authentic details, channels, images, and contact links. Do not invent fake stats or lorem ipsum.
instructions_to_main_agent.opening_rule: Ensure no portrait of Vishal is visible prior to the user interacting/scrolling through the 3D opening sequence.
instructions_to_main_agent.responsiveness: Ensure smooth 60fps WebGL canvas scaling and responsive DOM text safe zones across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid standard dark templates, centered generic layouts, and basic card grids. Craft high-end cinematic motion with explicit depth.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_readiness: Maintain clean HTML structure with data-testid on every clickable or data-bearing element.
